metadata.description: A curated agency of Claude Code agents, skills and guard hooks, distilled from the best open-source collections and rewritten to one standard.

plugins.name: core-workflow
plugins.description: Spec, plan, TDD, systematic debugging, verification-before-done, code review and git workflow skills, with a session-start bootstrap.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: PreToolUse hooks that block --no-verify, weakening lint/type configs, and destructive commands.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Evidence-gated reviewers, minimal-diff fixers, implementers and ops agents across web, mobile, backend and infra.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: PRDs, discovery, research synthesis, UX research, design critique, accessibility and brand.

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: SEO, AEO, ASO, copy, CRO, launches, community, lifecycle email, sales, support, pricing and fundraising.

plugins.name: ai-data-docs
plugins.description: MCP servers, LLM evals, RAG, prompt engineering, deep research, data and SQL analysis, docs and office files.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Write and test your own skills and agents, run agent teams, and manage context.

plugins.name: mcp-core
plugins.description: Keyless MCP servers that work on install: browser debugging and testing, live library docs, code graph and structural search, read-only SQL, mobile device control, document/Excel/YouTube conversion, diagrams, charts, UI components, icons.

plugins.name: mcp-cloud
plugins.description: Read-only Supabase, Kubernetes, AWS and Terraform docs using credentials you already have.

plugins.name: mcp-data-ops
plugins.description: Postgres tuning in restricted mode and Grafana observability.

plugins.name: mcp-business
plugins.description: Stripe, n8n, PostHog and Google Analytics.

plugins.name: mcp-research
plugins.description: Tavily, Firecrawl and SearXNG search and scraping.

plugins.name: mcp-creative
plugins.description: Penpot (open-source Figma), ComfyUI (local image/video/audio), Blender, plus optional Figma context and fal cloud models.
